cause_quote: The commit added `updateSlashMenu(target.value, state, slashMenuHost, requestUpdate);` to the composer's `handleSelect` textarea listener, and updateSlashMenu's argument branch sets `state.slashMenuIndex = 0`, so any native select event (keyboard text selection) reset the highlighted argument.
user_saw: After highlighting a slash-command argument such as `ultra` and then selecting text with Shift+Arrow, Tab completed the first/default argument instead, so `/think ultra` sent no thinking level.
summary: The slash menu now remembers the argument draft and keeps the highlighted argument by value when the same draft is re-parsed, instead of resetting the index to 0.
reasoning: The select-event path that re-runs the slash menu predates the graft; GraphQL blame at the graft attributes the `updateSlashMenu` call in `handleSelect` to f8550bc11d4d (#122425), whose diff shows it added that line to a listener that previously only updated the skill menu, while the arg branch already reset `slashMenuIndex = 0`. Later Solid-store refactors (3c099685538f) and the command-mode-only sibling fix 788093dbc81f (#193758) carried the reset unchanged. Medium because I did not run the pre-#122425 UI to confirm the arg highlight survived keyboard selection there, though the listener had no slash-menu call before.
